questions.chapter_title: Orbitals and Organic Chemistry: Pericyclic Reactions
questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “pericyclic reaction”?

options.label: A
options.text: A thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of a 1,5-diene proceeding through a chair-like six-membered transition state.

options.label: B
options.text: A process where bond-forming or bond-breaking events occur on OPPOSITE faces of a participating pi system.

options.label: C
options.text: A concerted chemical reaction that proceeds in a single step through a cyclic transition state with no ionic or radical intermediates.

options.label: D
options.text: A pericyclic reaction where two separate pi electron systems combine to form a new ring with the net loss of two pi bonds and gain of two sigma bonds.

questions.correct_answer: A concerted chemical reaction that proceeds in a single step through a cyclic transition state with no ionic or radical intermediates.
questions.explanation: A accurate description of pericyclic reaction is: A concerted chemical reaction that proceeds in a single step through a cyclic transition state with no ionic or radical intermediates.

options.label: B
options.text: disrotatory motion

options.label: C

questions.explanation: The best match is electrocyclic reaction: A reversible pericyclic reaction involving the intramolecular cyclization of a conjugated polyene to form a ring, or the reverse ring-opening.
